content: Khronos glTF 2.0.1 defines GLB as model/gltf-binary, uses meters and a right-handed coordinate system with +Y up and +Z forward, allows application-specific extras, and provides extensions for broader standardized features. Three.js can load GLB directly. Keep guide metadata in the existing persisted provider preview/contract data as the authority, optionally duplicate small metadata in GLB extras later, and validate exporter output with the Khronos validator as a development check.
